name: Animate on Scroll
description: Integrates the AOS (Animate On Scroll) JavaScript library; attaches the library and initializes it so elements animate as they scroll into view (module machine name: aos).
library_dependencies: michalsnik/aos (3.0.0-beta.6, loaded from cdnjs CDN or local libraries/aos)
project_description: Animate on Scroll (aos) is a thin Drupal integration for Michal Sajnog's AOS JavaScript library, which animates elements (fade, slide, zoom, etc.) as they scroll into and out of view. The module defines a single asset library (aos.libraries.yml) that pulls AOS 3.0.0-beta.6 CSS and JS from the cdnjs CDN, plus a small behavior (js/script.js) that calls AOS.init() on attach. A hook_library_info_alter() implementation swaps the CDN files for a locally installed copy under libraries/aos when present. There is no admin UI, no configuration, no routes, no permissions, no services and no config schema: authors opt individual elements into animation by adding data-aos markup attributes in templates, blocks or field markup. The library itself is not attached globally by default — a theme or module must attach the aos/aos library.
